classes.name: Hatch_Hatcher
classes.summary:
The Hatcher is an algorithm to compute cross hatchings in a 2d plane. It is mainly dedicated to display purpose.
Computing cross hatchings is a 3 steps process :
1. The users stores in the Hatcher a set of 2d lines to be trimmed. Methods in the "Lines" category.
2. The user trims the lines with a boundary. The inside of a boundary is on the left side. Methods in the "Trimming" category.
3. The user reads back the trimmed lines. Methods in the "Results" category.
The result is a set of parameter intervals on the line. The first parameter of an {@link Interval | `Interval`} may be `RealFirst()` and the last may be `RealLast()`.
A line can be a line parallel to the axis (X or Y line or a 2D line.
The Hatcher has two modes :
- The "Oriented" mode, where the orientation of the trimming curves is considered. The hatch are kept on the left of the trimming curve. In this mode infinite hatch can be computed.
- The "UnOriented" mode, where the hatch are always finite.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Returns an empty hatcher. <Tol> is the tolerance for intersections.

instanceMethods.name: AddLine
instanceMethods.comment: Add a line <L> to be trimmed. <T> the type is only kept from information. It is not used in the computation.

instanceMethods.name: AddLine
instanceMethods.comment:
Add an infinite line on direction <D> at distance <Dist> from the origin to be trimmed. <Dist> may be negative.
If O is the origin of the 2D plane, and V the vector perpendicular to D (in the direct direction).
A point P is on the line if : OP dot V = Dist The parameter of P on the line is OP dot D

instanceMethods.name: AddXLine
instanceMethods.comment: Add an infinite line parallel to the Y-axis at abciss <X>.

instanceMethods.name: AddYLine
instanceMethods.comment: Add an infinite line parallel to the X-axis at ordinate <Y>.

instanceMethods.name: Trim
instanceMethods.comment: Trims the lines at intersections with <L>.

instanceMethods.name: Trim
instanceMethods.signature: (L: gp_Lin2d, Start: number, End: number, Index: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Trims the lines at intersections with <L> in the parameter range <Start>, <End>.

instanceMethods.name: Trim
instanceMethods.signature: (P1: gp_Pnt2d, P2: gp_Pnt2d, Index: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Trims the line at intersection with the oriented segment P1,P2.

instanceMethods.name: NbIntervals
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the total number of intervals on all the lines.

instanceMethods.name: NbIntervals
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of intervals on line of index *.*

instanceMethods.name: NbLines
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the number of lines.

instanceMethods.name: Line
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the line of index *.*

instanceMethods.name: LineForm
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the type of the line of index *.*

instanceMethods.name: IsXLine
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the line of index *has a constant X value.*

instanceMethods.name: IsYLine
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the line of index *has a constant Y value.*

instanceMethods.name: Coordinate
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the X or Y coordinate of the line of index *if it is a X or a Y line.*

instanceMethods.name: Start
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the first parameter of interval <J> on line *.*

instanceMethods.name: End

instanceMethods.signature: (I: number, J: number, Index: number, Par2: number): { Index: number; Par2: number }
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the last Index and Par2 of interval <J> on line *.*
@returns A result object with fields:
- `Index`: updated value from the call.
- `Par2`: updated value from the call.

classes.name: Hatch_Line
classes.summary:
Stores a Line in the Hatcher. Represented by:
- A Lin2d from gp, the geometry of the line.
- Bounding parameters for the line.
- A sorted List of Parameters, the intersections on the line.

instanceMethods.name: AddIntersection
instanceMethods.signature: (Par1: number, Start: boolean, Index: number, Par2: number, theToler: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Insert a new intersection in the sorted list.

classes.name: Hatch_Parameter
classes.summary:
Stores an intersection on a line represented by :
- A Real parameter.
- A flag True when the parameter starts an interval.
